{{dablink|For the other Two Rivers resident, see [[Wit al'Seen]]. For others with the same surname, see [[The Congars and the Coplins]].}}

'''Wit Congar''' is a resident of [[Emond's Field]] in the [[Two Rivers]].{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Wit Congar|WC}}

== Appearance & Personality ==
He is a short scrawny individual who usually displays a sour expression to those with whom he interacts. His wife is twice as wide as him and generally overshadows him, both physically and otherwise.{{ref||WC}}{{ref/book|1|1}}

Like most of his [[The Congars and the Coplins|Congar]] kin he is regarded as a whiner and a complainer. He is generally lazy and rarely finishes the projects that he starts.{{ref/book|1|1}} He also has a tendency to be a busybody; always more concerned about what other people are doing and less focused on his own business. He is distrustful of the [[Women's Circle]] and frequently complains about its membership.

== History ==
He was born in Emond's Field and has been a farmer in the Two Rivers for his entire life. At some point in his youth he married [[Daise Congar]] who eventually became the village [[Wisdom]] in 999NE.

== Activities ==
He catches up with [[Tam al'Thor]] as he is heading into town, to complain about [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

He was part of the group that tried to fight off a band of Trollocs that turned out to be [[Tinkers]] seeking shelter. He participated in the defense of [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{Ref||WC}}
